#### Description
[Generic Config Updater](https://github.com/Azure/SONiC/blob/master/doc/config-generic-update-rollback/SONiC_Generic_Config_Update_and_Rollback_Design.md#91-unit-tests-for-apply-patch) has a test case about BGP listener which refers to the configDB table BGP_MONITORS

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. `apply-patch` to add config for BGP_MONITORS
2. action fails
3.

#### Describe the results you received:
```
admin@vlab-01:~$ sudo config apply-patch -i /FEATURE -i /QUEUE -i /SCHEDULER bgpl/add.json
Patch Applier: Patch application starting.
Patch Applier: Patch: [{"op": "add", "path": "/BGP_MONITORS", "value": {"<IP>": {"admin_status": "up", "asn": "65100", "holdtime": "10", "keepalive": "3", "local_addr": "<IP>", "name": "bgp_monitor", "nhopself": "0", "rrclient": "0"}}}]
Patch Applier: Getting current config db.
Patch Applier: Simulating the target full config after applying the patch.
Patch Applier: Validating target config does not have empty tables, since they do not show up in ConfigDb.
Patch Applier: Sorting patch updates.
Note: Below table(s) have no YANG models:
BGP_PEER_RANGE, CONSOLE_SWITCH, DEVICE_NEIGHBOR_METADATA, DHCP_SERVER, KDUMP, RESTAPI, SNMP, SNMP_COMMUNITY, TELEMETRY, BGP_MONITORS,
Note: Below table(s) have no YANG models:
BGP_MONITORS,
Failed to apply patch

```

#### Describe the results you expected:
`apply-patch` should not report miss Yang model
